identity.real_world_identity_notes: The EVO2 is distinct from the earlier Huracan LP 620-2 Super Trofeo. No predecessor telemetry alias is attached to this record.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct AMS2 cockpit inspection showed an open-top racing rim without an integrated display; exact diameter remains unknown.

notes: With Auto Clutch disabled, the car moved from rest without physical clutch input. The underlying simulator mechanism was not established.
All six paddle-selected forward gears accepted clutch-free full-throttle upshifts without driver lift, with automatic cut perceptible.
Clutch-free downshifts were accepted with no driver throttle input, and automatic blip was directly visible as a throttle-display spike.
Live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with Auto Clutch disabled.
Clutch-free move-off, six no-lift paddle upshifts with automatic cut, clutch-free downshifts with automatic blip, and the open-top no-display rim were directly observed.
The mechanism permitting clutch-free move-off was not determined.

confidence.basis: The exact identity and complete user-facing control technique were directly checked in AMS2; official sources independently establish the car identity and transmission hardware.

claims.basis: Official release and manufacturer material agree with the exact live model and class identity observed through SimHub 9.11.22.
Manufacturer documentation and direct exercise of all six paddle-selected forward gears agree.

Direct testing established clutch-free move-off, clutch-free no-lift upshifts with perceptible cut, and clutch-free downshifts with a visible automatic-blip spike. The move-off mechanism remains explicitly unknown.
Direct cockpit inspection classified the open-top no-display rim as GT-style in the project vocabulary.

notes: The old LamborghiniHuracanLP6202SuperTrofeo identity belongs to a different predecessor and is intentionally not included.

The wheel-rim shape was originally recorded as "gt-style". The separate "gt-style", "formula" and "prototype" values described the same rim: molded grips at 9 and 3 with a control face between them, usually carrying a display and rev lights. They are merged into "gt-formula". The rim was not observed again and nothing about the observation changed.
